This '''unidentified planet''' that [[Acid rain/Legends|rained acid]] as well as glass was the fourth planet of a remote system near an [[Unidentified planet (Lasgo Port)|unidentified planet]] which hosted the [[Spaceport/Legends|spaceport]] of [[Lasgo Port]]. This glass rain planet was home to a species of [[Unidentified giant beetle|giant beetles]] which ate glass. The planet was also known to have at least one settlement in [[139 ABY]]. Following [[Ania Solo]]'s kidnapping, her former flame [[Ramid]] flew his [[Ramid's starship|starship]] there in an attempt to refuel at the planet's settlement. However, they were attacked by a [[Unidentified masked bounty hunter|masked bounty hunter]] who shot down Ramid's ship. Ania and Ramid were forced to work together to survive. Later, the planet was visited by Ania's friends, who had come to rescue her, and a force of [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtroopers]] sent to arrest her.

==Behind the scenes==
[[Jason Fry]], author of the [[canon]] young-reader novel ''[[Servants of the Empire: The Secret Academy]]'', included a planet named [[Gesaral Beta]] that he intended as a reference to the unnamed planet from [[Star Wars: Legacy Volume 2|''Star Wars: Legacy'' Volume 2]].<ref name="dorkery">{{Tumblr|subdomain=jasonfry|url=post/158933265951/authors-notes-the-secret-academy-pt-1|name=Jason Fry's Dorkery|text=Author's Notes: The Secret Academy, Pt. 1}}</ref>
